_notes: Iron Man Vault Edition (Stern, 2014 re-issue of the 2010 game), SAM. Everything here comes from a
997-sample recording of live memory on im_185ve (2026-09-15) spanning an operator-menu session,
coins, one five-ball game with a mid-ball tilt on ball 1, a second five-ball game, and attract.
Adjustments are the '+2 family' (free play at record 35 from 0x02102008): Balls Per Game 3 -> 5
at record 32, Maximum Credits 30 -> 9 at record 34, Free Play toggled at 35, Ball Save Timer 5 -> 0
at 39, Standard Adjustment #1 (Replay Type) at 12. Each record is a 4-byte value, a check byte of
0xFF minus the byte sum, and three 0xFF pad bytes; declared as checksum8 with the check byte named.
Scores are 4-byte little-endian at 0x021109E4 (the same address Transformers uses), P1 climbing to
2,577,130 across the two games; P2-P4 stayed zero (single-player games) and follow at stride 4.
0x00034DB9 is the ball (1..5 in both games, parked at 5 through attract) and 0x00034DB8 the player.
0x00034DEA is the status bitfield SAM keeps at ball+0x31: 1 in attract, 20 in play, 22 for exactly
the eight samples between the tilt and the end of the tilted ball (player 1's score frozen at
115,590). game_over is mask 0x14 inverted, correct in all 997 samples; tilted is bit 0x02.
credits at 0x0211100C followed the coins and both starts (0, 1, 3, 2, 1). volume at 0x02110248 with
its complement check byte followed the operator menu through 40, 39, 38, 39, 40, 42.
Champion records are 32 bytes: three initials, 0xFF fill, score at +24, checksum16 (0xFFFF minus
the sum of the first 28 bytes) at +28. High scores are the five records from 0x02102C08 (75M, 55M,
40M, 30M, 25M with the factory initials). The eight mode champions follow from 0x02102CA8, all at
the factory ABC; their order matches the attract display and the default-threshold table at
0x02102298 (stride 0x18: six 5,000,000, then 10,000,000, then 25,000,000), so the labels are the
attract order read on the machine.
2026-11: tilted is the value 0x16 (mask 0x1F) on 0x00034DEA: bit 0x02 is set in 72, a mode value
a headless game read.
2026-11: The A.1 (64) and A.2 (50) adjustments added from the ROM image (README, 'Adjustments
from the ROM').
Confirmed on a cabinet 2026-11-13 (ALP4K; two players, tilt on P1 ball 1): 1,693,100 /
1,030,020, the records and the status byte (01, 14 play, 16 tilted) matched the DMD.
